name: flyt
label: Visma Flyt Skole
description: School messages, forms and weekly plans for your children, from Visma Flyt Skole (Min Skole / Flyt Foresatt).

FLYT_SCHOOL_KEY.label: School portal key
FLYT_SCHOOL_KEY.hint: The last part of https://foresatt.visma.no/<key>. Filled in for you when you log in, if the portal tells us.

FLYT_EVENTS.label: Weekly plans in the calendar
FLYT_EVENTS.hint: on (default) or off. Reads the PDF and Word files on recent school messages and puts what's on each day (trips, gym, when school ends, homework) on a calendar of its own in Clearsky.

FLYT_CALENDAR.label: Calendar for weekly plans
FLYT_CALENDAR.hint: The name of that calendar, School by default. Hide or show it from the day schedule like any other.

secrets.note: the three cookies from your BankID login, in the GNOME keyring (or ~/.config/clearsky/flyt-session.json)

note: The login opens a browser window on ID-porten; only the cookies for the school portal are kept.
outside: It logs in with BankID in a browser window and keeps the login in your keyring.
